configurations.name: Requirements baseline (16 KB ROM + 32 KB TCM + 128 KB SRAM)
configurations.note: Tiling the 4 KB 128-bit macro is area-prohibitive; it spends 31.8 mm2 on 176 KB.

configurations.name: 16 KB mask ROM + 32 KB TCM + 128 KB SRAM with 32-bit wide macros
configurations.note: Requires generating/obtaining 32-bit 128 KB and 32 KB macros with SS/FF/TT views; not currently in the repository.

findings: The 4 KB macro is 128 bits wide; a 128 KB memory built from it needs 32 instances and a 4:1 width adapter.
A 128 KB 32-bit macro is the area-correct choice but is not available in the audited platform.
Current macro has TT-only Liberty; multi-corner signoff is impossible without additional views.
ROM should be a mask ROM, not SRAM macros, for area, cost and immutability.

firmware_dependencies.linker: firmware/bare_metal/linker.ld uses bootrom 16K, tcm 32K, sram 128K, qspiflash 64M
firmware_dependencies.stack: firmware/boot/boot.S sets sp=0x2001_0000, the top of 128 KB SRAM
firmware_dependencies.boot_image: firmware/boot/boot.S is position-dependent at 0x0000_0000 and fits in 16 KB
firmware_dependencies.conclusion: Firmware already assumes the intended 16/32/128 sizes, not the oversized RTL arrays. RTL must be corrected, not firmware.

recommendation.rationale: Match the existing firmware, linker script and address map; reduce QSPI window to what the controller can address or add 4-byte addressing.
rtl_parameter_changes: qspi_flash_ctrl address width 24 -> 26 or 32 for 64 MB, or map shrinks to 16 MB
recommendation.macro_strategy: Do not tile the 4 KB 128-bit macro for bulk memory. Obtain/generate 32-bit wide 128 KB SRAM and 32 KB TCM macros with multi-corner Liberty, plus a 16 KB mask ROM. If unavailable, memory sizes or the 10 mm2 area target must be re-approved before Stage 3.
recommendation.ecc: Defer SECDED; it changes macro width and area and is optional in FR-MEM-006.

acceptance_criteria: One memory table approved and copied into SRS, linker docs and has_addr_map_pkg
